verdict.rationale: turbopuffer's own backups documentation describes server-side namespace copies that work across regions and cloud providers, and it also offers instant copy-on-write branching of a namespace. Together these act as snapshot-like backups, but the pack never documents an explicit restore workflow or named snapshot management. Missing for 10: an explicit restore-from-backup procedure, snapshot listing/retention/scheduling semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can back up collections with snapshots and restore them

citations.quote: Copies work across regions and across cloud providers (e.g., AWS to GCP).
Branch from namespace: instantly creates a copy-on-write clone of a namespace.
